title: Schedule of Deposits and Move-In Charges, RV & Boat Storage
content:
Schedule A to the RV & Boat Storage rental terms sets out the money collected when a space is reserved and when the unit moves in, and the periods attached to it.

**A-1. Amounts by space class (USD)**

| Space class | Reservation deposit | One-time administration fee at move-in | Refundable security deposit at move-in |
|---|---|---|---|
| Open Compact Storage Space | 25.00 | 20.00 | 50.00 |
| Open Standard Storage Space | 25.00 | 20.00 | 75.00 |
| Open Large Storage Space | 50.00 | 25.00 | 100.00 |
| Covered Standard Storage Space | 50.00 | 25.00 | 125.00 |
| Covered Large Storage Space | 50.00 | 25.00 | 150.00 |
| Enclosed Storage Unit | 100.00 | 35.00 | 250.00 |

**A-2. Periods and treatment (the same in every space class)**

| Item | Every class |
|---|---|
| Calendar days a reservation holds the space before move-in must occur | 14 |
| Reservation deposit applied to the first month's rent at move-in | yes |
| Calendar days after reserving within which a cancellation refunds the reservation deposit | 3 |
| Calendar days after move-out within which the security deposit is refunded | 30 |

Footnotes to Schedule A:

- The reservation deposit and the security deposit are deposits held for the rental; the administration fee is a one-time fee added to the amount the resident owes on the rental, not a deposit.
- Hypothetical illustration of A-1: a resident who reserves an Enclosed Storage Unit pays a 100.00 reservation deposit; at move-in the rental is charged the 35.00 administration fee and the 250.00 security deposit, and the 100.00 reservation deposit is applied to the first month's rent.
- The two short periods in A-2 measure different things: 14 days is how long the reservation holds the space, and 3 days is the window after the reservation date within which a cancellation still refunds the reservation deposit.
